application.name: Depth to Point Cloud
application.description: Deprojects organized depth images (uint16 or float32) into organized, optionally colored, point clouds on the GPU with a reusable Holoscan 5 operator.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: DepthToPointCloudOp with optional color and per-frame intrinsics, synthetic and PGM depth sources, PLY output.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Deproject 300 frames of a synthetic depth camera with color, checking every point and color against ground truth.

images.description: Deproject the 8- or 16-bit PGM depth images in the data directory. Pass the camera's intrinsics with --run-args.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic uint16 frames with color and per-frame intrinsics, every point and color checked against ground truth.
